Guidance: Accept $1.1749<z\leq1.175$ or the corresponding negative value.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(-1.5<Z<1.5)=\Phi(1.5)-\Phi(-1.5)$ [M1]
Guidance: Both $1.5$ and $-1.5$ used as z-values, or an equivalent symmetric-tail method, with no other z-value.
$P(-1.5<Z<1.5)=2\Phi(1.5)-1=2(0.9332)-1$ [M1]
Guidance: Calculate the central area from cumulative probabilities at equal-magnitude opposite z-values; condone use of $0.0668=1-0.9332$.
$P(-1.5<Z<1.5)=0.8664$ [A1]
Guidance: Accept a one-adult probability rounding to $0.866$.
$(0.8664)^3=0.650$ [B1 FT]
Guidance: Follow through the candidate’s one-adult probability, carried to at least 4 significant figures, and cube it; final answer may be 3 significant figures.
Total: 4
